title: Engineering Apprenticeship
description: Design manufacture and test precision measurement systems.
typical_quals: GCSEs incl Maths English; A-levels/BTEC Engineering or Physics helpful
useful_projects: CAD mini-project; Arduino/sensor build; STEM competition
application_tips: Apply early; show practical STEM evidence

title: Graduate Software / Engineering
description: Graduate routes into software metrology and engineering teams.
typical_quals: STEM degree preferred
useful_projects: GitHub portfolio; robotics/automation project
application_tips: Highlight teamwork and manufacturing context interest

title: Aerospace Manufacturing Apprentice
description: Hands-on aerospace manufacturing and quality processes.
typical_quals: GCSEs Maths English Science; DT/Engineering preferred
useful_projects: Workshop skills; CAD; health & safety awareness
application_tips: Be ready to discuss why aerospace / Gloucestershire

title: Flight Controls Engineering Pathway
description: Engineering support for aerospace flight control products.
typical_quals: Maths Physics Engineering Level 3 or equivalent
useful_projects: Electronics kit; systems thinking examples
application_tips: Show curiosity about how aircraft systems work

title: Cyber Security Apprenticeship (cluster SMEs)
description: Entry cyber roles via Cheltenham cyber SME network.
typical_quals: IT/Computer Science helpful; attitude and learning agility key
useful_projects: TryHackMe/HackTheBox; home lab; CompTIA interest
application_tips: Network via CyNam events; build a learning log

title: Graduate Analyst / Engineer
description: Intelligence and software roles supporting financial crime detection.
typical_quals: CS Data Cyber or related degree
useful_projects: Python project; data cleaning notebook; OSINT interest
application_tips: Demonstrate ethics and attention to detail

title: Agri-tech Internship
description: Support startups in food farming and agri-tech innovation.
typical_quals: Agri environmental CS or business background useful
useful_projects: Farm tech idea; sustainability project; market research
application_tips: Show interest in real-world farming problems

title: Land-based / Equine / Sport Pathways
description: Practical and academic pathways into land-based industries.
typical_quals: Relevant Level 2/3 land-based or sport quals
useful_projects: Volunteering on farm/stable/sports coaching
application_tips: Emphasise outdoor practical experience

title: Healthcare Support Worker / Nursing Associate routes
description: Patient-facing and clinical support careers in the NHS.
typical_quals: GCSEs; care certificate interest; values-based recruitment
useful_projects: Care volunteering; first aid; reflective journal
application_tips: Prepare values examples (compassion teamwork)

title: Local Government Apprenticeship / Graduate
description: Digital business environment and community roles in the council.
typical_quals: Varies by scheme; often Level 3+
useful_projects: Community project; digital skills; admin experience
application_tips: Show commitment to public service locally

title: Events / Marketing Internship
description: Support festival operations marketing and audience experience.
typical_quals: Any; creative communications or events interest
useful_projects: Event volunteering; social content samples
application_tips: Seasonal peaks; flexibility valued

title: Retail / Commercial / Design Pathways
description: Store head office and design-adjacent opportunities.
typical_quals: Retail experience helpful
useful_projects: Personal brand project; merchandising ideas
application_tips: Customer service stories land well

title: Sustainability / Green Energy Roles
description: Commercial and sustainability-focused roles in green energy.
typical_quals: Business environment STEM or related
useful_projects: Carbon footprint project; energy market research
application_tips: Passion for climate solutions matters

title: Mechanical / Manufacturing Apprentice
description: Apprenticeships supporting industrial steam and thermal products.
typical_quals: Maths English; Engineering preferred
useful_projects: Workshop project; CAD basics
application_tips: Ask about training centre and mentor support

title: Food Science Technician / Graduate
description: Lab and applied food science roles.
typical_quals: Science A-levels or food science degree
useful_projects: Lab report samples; food safety awareness
application_tips: Highlight hygiene and precision

title: Teacher Training (PGCE / QTS)
description: Initial teacher training for primary or secondary — PGCE and school-led QTS routes with local placements.
typical_quals: Degree (or equivalent); GCSE English Maths (and Science for primary)
useful_projects: School volunteering or TA experience; short teaching activity
application_tips: Apply via DfE Apply; prepare safeguarding and subject knowledge examples

title: Teaching Assistant Apprenticeship
description: Support teachers in class with learning behaviour and pupil wellbeing — common first step into teaching.
typical_quals: GCSEs English Maths; patience and communication
useful_projects: Youth work volunteering; literacy/numeracy tutoring; reflective journal
application_tips: Show examples of helping learners; ask about SEND and progression to HLTA/QTS

title: Early Years Educator Pathway
description: Nursery and early years roles working with under-5s under the EYFS framework.
typical_quals: Interest in childcare; DBS readiness
useful_projects: Babysitting; playgroup volunteering; EYFS awareness notes
application_tips: Emphasise care safeguarding and play-based learning

title: Hotel Chef / Front of House Apprentice
description: Kitchen or guest-facing hotel roles with structured hospitality training.
typical_quals: GCSEs helpful; food hygiene interest for chef routes
useful_projects: Part-time cafe/kitchen work; allergen awareness
application_tips: Ask about rotation across departments and supervisor progression

title: Pub & Restaurant Hospitality Apprentice
description: Chef waiting bar or hospitality supervisor pathways in pubs and inns.
typical_quals: Customer service attitude; team working
useful_projects: Part-time hospitality shifts; food hygiene certificate
application_tips: Highlight pace teamwork and weekend flexibility

title: Cotswolds Hotel / Restaurant Apprentice
description: Independent hotel and restaurant apprenticeships in tourism-heavy Cotswold towns.
typical_quals: Any; passion for hospitality and local tourism
useful_projects: Customer service examples; seasonal event volunteering
application_tips: Target Cirencester Cheltenham and Cotswold employers on Find an Apprenticeship

title: Plumbing & Domestic Heating Apprentice
description: Install and maintain plumbing and heating systems; pathway to qualified plumber / heating engineer.
typical_quals: GCSEs Maths English helpful; practical hands-on attitude
useful_projects: DIY plumbing-safe projects; measuring tasks; workshop experience
application_tips: Ask about gas pathway timing and college day-release

title: Installation / Maintenance Electrician Apprentice
description: Electrotechnical apprenticeship toward qualified electrician status in domestic or commercial settings.
typical_quals: GCSEs Maths English; colour vision and practical aptitude
useful_projects: Wiring kit practice; D&T electronics; problem-solving examples
application_tips: Confirm AM2 / end-point assessment support with the employer

title: Bricklaying / Site Trade Apprentice
description: Housebuilding site apprenticeships such as bricklaying joinery or groundworks.
typical_quals: Practical outdoor work preference; Maths English helpful
useful_projects: D&T making; landscaping; construction taster days
application_tips: Be ready for site starts PPE and weather; ask about trade choice

title: Carpentry & Joinery Apprentice
description: Site carpenter or bench joiner routes with contractors and housebuilders.
typical_quals: Workshop or D&T experience valued
useful_projects: Woodwork portfolio photos; accurate measuring practice
application_tips: Ask whether the role is site-based or workshop-based

title: Scaffolding / Groundworks Apprentice
description: Outdoor construction support trades — scaffolding or groundworks with civils and housebuilders.
typical_quals: Fitness for outdoor physical work; teamwork
useful_projects: Any outdoor practical work examples
application_tips: Discuss CSCS and progression to advanced craft or gang leader roles
